title: 第1187章 死了的天才算什么狗屁第1186章 你们要在妖域猎杀云小友
slug: 重生魔帝开局骗女帝下界双修
content_zh:
这里是镇妖殿的最深处。
即使是妖后这样的存在，也别想窥视到其中的秘密。
而此刻，这里却是在进行着一场密谋。
镇妖殿殿主叶玄，叶家之主，号玄天剑主，准帝修为，镇压妖域，功在千秋。
但是成也妖域败也妖域，如今受制于妖域天道限制，无法成帝。
而叶家也是人丁凋零，嫡系血脉只剩下了叶倾仙一人。
其余都被妖域猎杀或者死于战争之中。
两位儿子也是身死道消。
而在叶玄对面的，也是仙盟赫赫有名的刽子手。
北冥仙尊，仙盟冥器北冥幽魂幡执掌者。
曾经血腥镇压无尽海，几乎让整个无尽海都被鲜血染红了。
在某种意义上来说，两人其实都算是惺惺相惜的道友了。
只是北冥终究还是棋差一着，距离准帝始终差一步。
而那一步，或许是气运，也或许是受制于北冥幽魂幡的业力。
不过从他在无尽海碰到女帝被斩本源这件事情来看，或许真的是运气不好吧。
而这一次，本应该在闭关养伤之中的他再次出现在了妖域。
而且直接来到了叶玄的面前。
此刻，作为仙盟之中两位杀气最重业力最大的元勋重臣。
却是在秘议要猎杀仙盟第一天骄。
北冥仙尊抬了抬眼眸。

他看向叶玄。
又看了一眼四周。
“你这里足够安全？”他有些谨慎道。
毕竟他们接下来的对话，甚至可以说是有了取死之道。
万一走漏风声，那都是惊天动地的大事情。
甚至整个仙盟顷刻间就要分崩离析。
哪怕是白帝圣君从帝关归回，都压不住场面。
“我们的对话，帝境也察觉不到。”
叶玄很有信心的说道。
“如此甚好。”北冥仙尊这才松了口气。
这一次他们其实有三条线，他这一边才是最重要的一个环节。
“只是，我小女要是出了事情，你们谁都别想踏出妖域。”
叶玄又忽然淡淡道。
他这话说的很轻巧，但是北冥知道这其中的分量有多大。
叶玄这老东西在仙盟的封疆大史之中，也就仅次于无尽海那位东极帝君。
若是不业力太大，说不定早就破境了。
当然了，也因为无尽海那边有海外修士，气运鼎盛。
不过要说最倒霉的，还是自己啊。
北冥也是走投无路了。
被传奇女帝斩了十分之一本源之后，他的路几乎就断绝了。

好在帝君垂怜，还是赐予了他至宝，毕竟他没有功劳也有苦劳。
为了仙盟，他脏活累活干的可是不少。
如今虽说还没恢复到巅峰，也是时日问题。
content_en:
This is the deepest part of the Demon Suppression Palace.
Even a being like the Demon Queen can't even think of peeking into the secrets.
But at this moment, a conspiracy is going on here.
Ye Xuan, the master of the Demon Suppression Hall, the master of the Ye family, also known as Xuantian Sword Master, is a quasi-emperor who has made great achievements in suppressing the demon realm.
However, if you succeed in the Demon Realm and lose in the Demon Realm, you are now restricted by the Demon Realm's heavenly laws and cannot become an emperor.
The Ye family is also declining, with only Ye Qingxian left in the direct lineage.
The rest were hunted by the demon realm or died in the war.
The two sons also died.
Opposite Ye Xuan was also a famous executioner from the Immortal League.
Beiming Immortal Lord, the person in charge of the Immortal Alliance's underworld weapon, the Beiming Ghost Flag.
There was a bloody suppression of the Endless Sea, and almost the entire Endless Sea was stained red with blood.
In a sense, the two of them are actually sympathetic Taoist friends.
It's just that Beiming is still one step away from the quasi-emperor.
And that step may be due to luck, or it may be the karma of being controlled by the Beiming Ghost Flag.
But judging from the fact that he met the empress who was beheaded in the Endless Sea, maybe it was really bad luck.
But this time, he, who was supposed to be recuperating in seclusion, appeared in the Demon Realm again.
And he came directly in front of Ye Xuan.
At this moment, as the two great ministers with the most murderous intent and the greatest karma in the Immortal Alliance.
But they are secretly planning to hunt down the Immortal Alliance's number one genius.
Beiming Immortal Lord raised his eyes.
He looked at Ye Xuan.
He looked around again.
"Is it safe enough here?" he asked cautiously.
After all, their next conversation could even be said to be a recipe for death.
If the news leaks out, it will be an earth-shattering event.
Even the entire Immortal Alliance will fall apart in an instant.
Even if the Holy Lord Baidi returns from Diguan, he can't suppress the scene.
"The Emperor Realm won't be able to notice our conversation."
Ye Xuan said with confidence.
"That's very good." Immortal Lord Beiming breathed a sigh of relief.
This time they actually have three lines, and his side is the most important link.
"It's just that if something happens to my little girl, none of you will be able to step out of the demon realm."
Ye Xuan suddenly said lightly again.
He said it very lightly, but Bei Ming knew how much weight it held.
In the history of the Immortal Alliance's feudal territory, this old guy Ye Xuan is second only to the Emperor of the East Pole in the Endless Sea.
If it wasn't for too much karma, it might have broken through long ago.
Of course, it's also because there are overseas monks on the other side of the Endless Sea, and their luck is booming.
But the most unlucky person is myself.
Beiming was also desperate.
After being cut off by a tenth of his origin by the legendary empress, his path was almost cut off.
Fortunately, the emperor took pity on him and gave him the treasure. After all, he had no merit but hard work.
For the sake of the Immortal Alliance, he did a lot of dirty work.
Although it has not yet returned to its peak, it is still a matter of time.
